purpose: Measure how the already frozen fourteen-slot short-rebuy cap transfers to the earlier full calendar year and its severe April drawdown.
window: 2024-01-01 00:00 UTC through 2024-12-31 23:55 UTC, 366 daily decisions and 105408 five-minute marks, separate initial capital of 1000 USDT.
controls: Independently reconciled 2024 fourteen-slot uncapped and twelve-slot FlatTopBoost accounts, at 15 bp per side. Preserve the same Binance USD-M dated universe, 3x isolated contract, pinned engine and annual loader, execution and cash accounting.
mutation: Compose the exact source files registered for the current capped fourteen-slot account. Only cap cumulative filled initial margin at twice first-entry margin for pure short Rebuy tags 561, 562, 563. Retain entry signals, stake multiplier, gross slot limit, exits, and unscoped position adjustments.
evaluation: Compare capped and uncapped fourteen-slot net return, maximum five-minute marked drawdown, and number of natural exits netting 1% or more of pre-entry marked NAV. Reuse the current cap's higher-return, no-worse-drawdown, at-least-as-many-large-winners, effective-cap and zero-liquidations criteria. Also report capped drawdown against the twelve-slot reference and the fate of the observed GMT trade if matched.
scope: Earlier transfer and stress run. Observed uncapped results and the GMT selection diagnostic were available at registration. The capped economic path has not been observed. This is a historical simulation rather than a production qualification.
